title: Chinese Ink bamboo terminal spray – source-to-structure study
goal: Original seed-addressable code-rendered xieyi bamboo scene for 960×540 animated video; dense terminal brush cluster, thin support wood, exposed rice-paper gaps.
rights: No museum bitmap assets imported, traced, or distributed; all paths are original procedural geometry. NPM digital archive lists CC0 up to 1MP and CC BY 4.0 at 6MP; linked images are cited and not embedded.

reference_sources.title: Manual of Ink Bamboo (墨竹譜)
inspected_regions: negative space between long vertical trailing blades
observations: main arm bends once in a broad arc
short twig bone runs through leaf roots
alternating long/short one-pull brushes meet near terminal branch, dark strokes partially overlap
large open paper channels survive beside the grouped black marks

reference_sources.title: Manual of Ink Bamboo (墨竹譜)
inspected_regions: shooting leaf group at lower left
low-light leaf fan at lower right
observations: strong vertical culms have conspicuous bare internodes
leaf groups at one joint meet at a woody connection and separate into unequal sweeps
brush load varies within a stroke; major background remains unpainted

reference_sources.title: Orchids and Bamboo
reference_sources.rights: Visual study only; check the museum's object terms before reusing media
observations: thin support branches contrast with broad tapered leaf groups
ink weight is intentionally uneven and leaf heading is not mechanically radial

reference_sources.artist: National Gallery of Victoria curatorial essay
reference_sources.title: Wu Zhen’s Bamboo in Spring Rain
inspected_regions: described brush operation and negative-space rhythm
observations: leaves, branches and shoots are made by swift single strokes
negative-space shapes between strokes are a major motif, not accidental gaps

nodes: two-mask split-bristle reserves at each gesture when detail>.85
edges: main twig 0.68 normalized station → terminal spray twig
terminal twig normalized stations 0.22/0.33/0.46/0.55/0.68/0.78/0.88 → ink leaf roots
leaf root → tip under branch tangent + authored heading offset
pressure silhouette → luminance mask → two internal paper gaps

shape_specification.variation: Small seeded jitter only; topology and root stations locked to parent curve. These are authored procedural proportions, not measured/pixel-traced source distances.
shape_specification.animation: Inherited from common parent branch transform; pure absolute frame position and same wind yaw.

assertions: all 63 visible hero leaves at detail=1 begin at painted quadratic stem station
9 hero twig roots attach to parent branch
topology.source_comparison: Pending independently measured source/candidate semantic masks; tests only assert authored geometry.

assertions: each leaf heading derived from supporting twig quadratic tangent
7 authored alternating headings are present per hero cluster
flow.source_comparison: Manual directional review of source and native crop required.

assertions: every hero leaf uses 15 pressured stations and unequal left/right sides
every full-detail hero leaf uses a directional ink gradient
pressure.source_comparison: Real raster stroke width distribution not independently benchmarked.

assertions: high detail hero groups at 9/21 joints

release_gate.technical: TypeScript, focused unit, Chromium 5-card Storybook crop study, 960×540 96-frame MP4, seed=71 and 87 stability.
release_gate.visual: Compare 1-stroke and complete-cluster study to WZ-A/WZ-B at full film size and zoom. Assess gaps, crossings, ink load and texture without overfitting to a pixel match. Check all three scenes.
release_gate.current: candidate; not art approved, do not merge based on CI alone.

visual_review_v12.inspected: v12 native 2.15x brushwork crops and misty-hermit normal film frame
visual_review_v12.observed_problem: Extra leaves increase dark clustered coverage but many are near-vertical dark knife shapes. Source NPM image 17010703 has more hanging/side-swept leaves beneath its arching bough, so pressure alone is insufficient.
visual_review_v12.change: Rebalance seven authored relative headings toward horizontal and drooping sweeps, preserve the one attached parent twig and all tonal masks.
visual_review_v12.approval: pending new exact-head native review; not an artistic pass
